segments.text: GIVE vs this daie our daily bread.
In this petition wee deſire corporall bleſſinges, concerning which wee are to obſerue theſe queſtions.

1 Why corporal bleſſings are to bee deſired.
2 How they are to be deſired.
3 Why Chriſt compriſed corporal bleſſings vnder the name of Bread.
4 Why he calleth it our bread.
5 Why he calleth it daiely bread.
6 Why he addeth, This day.
7 Whether it be lawful to deſire riches.
8 Whether it be lawful to treaſure vp any thing for the time to come.
